name: Bayou Beast

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Spirits Susceptibility
traits.summary: Each bottle of alcohol splashed on it deals 9 (2d8) Force and sets its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn.
traits.text: Alcohol washes the jinx seals away. For every bottle splashed over the elemental it takes 9 (2d8) Force damage and its Speed drops to 0 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Hexed Slam
actions.summary: +8, reach 10 ft, 3d8+5 Bludgeoning; DC 16 Wis save or cursed until its next turn (-1d4 on attack rolls and saving throws).
actions.text: A creature that is hit makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or is cursed until the start of the elemental's next turn. While cursed it subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls and saving throws.

actions.name: Swamp Grasp
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. Each creature on the ground within 20 ft, DC 16 Str save: 2d10 Poison and Restrained for 1 minute (an action and a DC 16 Athletics check, by it or a neighbour, frees it).
actions.text: Swamp water and plants coil round every creature standing on the ground within 20 feet. Failure: 11 (2d10) Poison damage and Restrained for 1 minute, or until the elemental is Incapacitated or dies. The target, or a creature within 5 feet of it, can use an action to make a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check and end the Restrained condition on a success.

summary: A swamp spirit bound into a heap of rotting plants by jinx seals: it slams cursed blows and drags everything nearby into the mire. Alcohol washes its seals away.
